# NexyFab

> Browser-based, AI-assisted precision CAD and manufacturing workspace.

- [NexyFab](https://nexyfab.com/)
- [Shape Generator](https://nexyfab.com/ko/shape-generator/)
- [Documentation](https://nexyfab.com/ko/docs/)

NexyFab combines parametric shape generation, feature-tree editing, assembly
workflows, DFM feedback, and manufacturing quotation tools. Generated geometry
and solver results must be verified before production use.
